verdict.rationale: Kit's API/MCP lets an agent manage subscribers, segments/tags, and broadcasts (kit-docs-2, kit-docs-20, kit-docs-23), and the official Kit MCP explicitly allows an AI client to 'read and write to a creator's Kit account' (kit-docs-20), covering audiences and campaign creation. However, there is no evidence of an endpoint or MCP capability for pulling automation status or campaign performance/reporting metrics, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (kit-probe-2), leaving the 'live automations' and 'campaign results' reporting pieces unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented automation-status/reporting endpoints, evidence of campaign analytics retrieval via API/MCP, independent confirmation of MCP read capabilities in practice.
